word: _*Nwyrv*_ shiryown or _*Nyrv*_ shiryon and _*Nyrv*_ shiryan also (fem.) _*hyrv*_ shiryah and _*hnyrv*_ shiryonah
etymology: from 08281 in the original sense of turning
avSummary: habergeon 3, coat 2, harness 2, coat of mail 1, breastplate 1
definition:
1) body armour
 2) a weapon
    2a) perhaps a lance, javelin
